# Code of conduct

Be respectful, patient, and specific.

People turn up here from recruiting, clinical work, data, design, and software,
and they will not all share your assumptions. Criticize the work, not the person.
No harassment, threats, discrimination, sexualised language, deliberate
misgendering, doxxing, or posting somebody's private job-search material.

The maintainer will edit or remove content, close a discussion, or restrict
participation where that is what keeps this project safe and useful. Something
serious or sensitive goes to the maintainer privately rather than being argued
out in public.

This holds in repository discussions and anywhere else representing the project.
